input: Create files: /tmp/notes.txt with 'remember this', /tmp/data.csv with 'a,b,c', /tmp/script.sh with '#!/bin/bash'. Create a tar.gz archive /tmp/bundle.tar.gz containing all three files. Then list the archive contents. Finally extract only notes.txt to /output/ directory.

transcript.final_response:
Created all three files and `/tmp/bundle.tar.gz`.

Archive contents:
```text
notes.txt
data.csv
script.sh
```

Extracted only `notes.txt` to `/output/notes.txt`.
tool_calls:
printf '%s\n' 'remember this' > /tmp/notes.txt
printf '%s\n' 'a,b,c' > /tmp/data.csv
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' > /tmp/script.sh
tar -czf /tmp/bundle.tar.gz -C /tmp notes.txt data.csv script.sh && tar -tzf /tmp/bundle.tar.gz && mkdir -p /output && tar -xzf /tmp/bundle.tar.gz -C /output notes.txt
